job.title: SAP Solution Architect
job.description:
This is: the job
An opportunity for a Senior Solution Architect to take a key role in a complex enterprise transformation, shaping application architecture across Finance, Supply Chain, Retail, HR, Data and Integration.

You will bring deep SAP architecture expertise while maintaining an enterprise-first perspective, helping drive clean-core, integration-led and cloud-aligned solutions. The environment spans large-scale ERP transformation, master data governance, integration rationalisation, identity and security modernisation, and retail and supply chain convergence.

This is a 12 month contract based in Melbourne, suited to an experienced architect comfortable operating across complex multi-vendor, multi-cloud and regulated environments.

This is: what you'll do
  • Lead end-to-end solution architecture across Finance, Supply Chain, Retail, HR, Data and Integration.
  • Design conceptual and logical architectures, integration patterns, data ownership models and security-aligned solutions.
  • Drive clean-core architecture and appropriate SAP BTP and SaaS extensibility approaches.
  • Lead API-first and event-driven integration design while reducing point-to-point dependencies.
  • Define master data ownership and governance across product, supplier, customer and finance domains.
  • Ensure solutions align with Microsoft Entra ID, SAP IAS/IPS, ServiceNow provisioning and privileged access controls where applicable.
  • Present architecture proposals and structured option analysis to the Architecture Review Board.
  • Assess solution options across risk, cost, complexity and technical debt.
  • Drive alignment to target architecture while balancing commercial pragmatism with technical discipline.
This is: what you'll need
  • Significant enterprise solution architecture experience, with the role brief calling for 10+ years.
  • Strong architecture experience across SAP S/4HANA and SAP Business Technology Platform.
  • Experience with SAP Master Data Governance and SAP SuccessFactors.
  • Demonstrated experience designing end-to-end SAP S/4HANA solutions at scale.
  • Strong understanding of SAP clean-core, RISE and cloud deployment models.
  • Experience leading architecture across major ERP or enterprise transformation programs.
  • Knowledge of API-led integration, middleware governance and event-driven architecture.
  • Strong understanding of enterprise data governance, IAM, role-based access and segregation of duties.
  • Experience in regulated or high-volume retail or distribution environments.
  • Ability to communicate complex architecture clearly and influence senior stakeholders, program leaders and vendors.
This is: the perks
  • Shape architecture across a broad, enterprise-scale transformation landscape.
  • Work across SAP, cloud, integration, data, security and major business platforms rather than a single functional domain.
  • Gain high visibility through architecture governance and strategic solution design.
  • Deliver tangible simplification across technical debt, customisation, integration and enterprise application architecture.

job.title: SAP Reporting and Analytics Lead
job.description:
This is: the job

An opportunity exists for an experienced SAP Reporting and Analytics Lead to join a major SAP S/4HANA transformation program in Melbourne. This is a 12 month contract in a hybrid environment, suited to a hands-on leader who can shape reporting strategy while staying close to design, delivery and quality.

You will lead the reporting and analytics workstream across the SAP analytics landscape, including SAP Analytics Cloud, SAP Datasphere, embedded analytics and Fiori-based reporting. The role will translate business reporting needs into a clear, governed analytics architecture and ensure dashboards, reports, KPIs and data models are trusted from go-live.

This is a high-impact role working across data, functional, technical and business teams. You will partner with senior stakeholders, guide delivery resources, challenge legacy reporting habits and help build a reporting capability that supports better decisions across a complex enterprise environment.

This is: what you'll do
  • Lead the reporting and analytics workstream across SAP S/4HANA, SAP Analytics Cloud, SAP Datasphere and embedded analytics
  • Define the target-state analytics architecture, reporting strategy, standards and roadmap
  • Drive requirements workshops with business stakeholders and functional leads across statutory, operational, management and self-service reporting
  • Oversee the design and build of reports, dashboards, KPIs, semantic models, CDS views and analytical data model.
  • Manage reporting governance, including naming conventions, KPI definitions, version control, lineage and business glossary alignment
  • Drive report rationalisation by challenging legacy lift-and-shift requests and promoting standardisation
  • Collaborate with data migration, master data, security, integration and technical architecture teams to ensure reporting is secure, scalable and supportable
  • Manage reporting test strategy across SIT, UAT and reconciliation against source and legacy systems
  • Lead reporting developers, analysts and partner resources to deliver the reporting backlog
  • Support transition to operations, including hypercare, support processes, knowledge transfer and documentation
This is: what you'll need
  • Proven experience leading reporting or analytics workstreams on a full-lifecycle SAP S/4HANA implementation
  • Strong working knowledge of SAP Analytics Cloud, SAP Datasphere, SAP Data Products and S/4HANA embedded analytics
  • Experience with CDS views, Fiori analytical apps, semantic models, dashboards and SAP reporting architecture
  • Solid understanding of SAP data models and reporting-relevant modules such as FI/CO, MM, SD, PP or similar
  • Experience defining data governance standards, KPI definitions, reconciliation controls and reporting quality frameworks
  • Strong stakeholder engagement skills, with the ability to manage senior business, technology and delivery stakeholders
  • Demonstrated ability to lead mixed teams of analysts, developers and implementation partner resources
  • Strong analytical judgement, with the confidence to balance standardisation against genuine business need
  • Clear written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to present to technical and executive audiences
  • A degree in business, technology or a related field, or equivalent practical experience
This is: the perks
  • Lead a critical analytics workstream on a major SAP S/4HANA transformation
  • Shape the reporting architecture, governance model and Day 1 decision-support capability
  • Work with senior stakeholders across data, technology, functional teams and business reporting ownership
